entities.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
entities.description: A spymaster who keeps his sources secret and knows the bounties placed on others' heads.

entities.name: Kaalia of the Vast
entities.description: A figure sworn to revenge, willing to call on every force from above and below.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A sword that slew a false god on Dominaria and still radiated power afterward.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane from which a false god tore the magic.

entities.name: Vela the Night-Clad
entities.description: A figure who wipes out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving nightfall behind her.

entities.name: Krond
entities.description: A ruler whose reign Vela erases.

events.summary: In the past, a false god tore the magic from Dominaria and was slain by the Mirari sword, which still radiates power.
events.quote: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

events.summary: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign.
events.quote: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

relations.note: Vela erases all traces of Krond's reign.
relations.quote: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign

relations.note: The Mirari sword radiates power on Dominaria after slaying the false god.
relations.quote: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.
